text:
Type: bent metal wall shelf
Use: displaying books, frames and small decor; living room, bedroom, home office, hallway
Style: minimalist, modern, contemporary
Materials: powder-coated bent steel sheet
Colors: off-white, warm light cream
Shape: wide U-shaped open profile with a top lip, tall back panel and flat bottom shelf, thin folded edges, sculptural yet simple, light visual weight
Feel: soft, clean, quiet, graphic
Goes with: white or pastel walls, light wood, ceramics, brass accents; minimalist, Scandinavian or modern rooms

product.name: BOTKYRKA
product.description: The wall shelf makes it easy for you to see and reach the things you use every day.
